posts.name: Sonvar
posts.cooked:
1.  Baron Blade's episode is my favorite so far.  A lot of background and a story that goes from being the main villain to at least becoming a hero in the end.  The hero part was temporary but still a neat transition along with the questions from heroes about why he has these Doomsday devices.  I'm more curious about his role in the RPG as wwell because of this.  It also had one of the biggest reveals to me in that he founded RevoCorp which up to that point we had no idea on any of their background. 

2.  The Setback episode is my least favorite.  I feel there was a lot of more story to tell of his conflicts with RevoCorp between Plague Rat and Revenant that the questions didn't get into at all.  

3 & 4. I don't have a most or least favorite Interlude episode.  They've all had something to pique my interest.

posts.name: KateWalker
posts.cooked: I wanna say my favorite so far has been Nightmist, or maybe Gloomweaver. Getting into the magical side of the Multiverse, there was a whole lot more to be learned than I anticipated. Least favorite is probably the Freedom Five; even Christopher and Adam admitted they'd already gone over most of the story elements in previous episodes. At least there's always good questions! Interludes I don't recall as well. :B
